prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Uma alma sem disciplina é como um navio sem leme.

meta.face: An Englishman of Danish blood, about sixty-five, fair-skinned with a light ruddy colour, of a noble, well-proportioned build, with a LONG, HANDSOME face — a broad, high forehead, a LONG, NARROW, straight nose, HIGH, broad cheekbones, deep-set, clear blue eyes under straight, fair-grey brows, a firm, CLEAN-CUT jaw and a strong chin; a calm, finely drawn mouth; silver-fair hair cut level at the ears; a SHORT, neat, silver-fair beard close along the jaw; the gaze kindly and direct.
meta.basis: No likeness from life. The book calls him 'endowed with a very rare and beautiful form of body', and Wikipedia gives his Danish parentage and his death while washing the feet of the poor on 29 February 992; the card keeps both. Wikipedia's lead image, a Ramsey Psalter miniature of c. 1300 (Commons calls it only 'a bishop above a ram'), shows a mitred bishop with a short beard. The book has no engraving for this day.
